settings.title: Made in Kashmir
settings.body: Made in the valley, in small batches, by people from here. The place is the point.

settings.title: Bold by design
settings.body: Big fizz, bigger personality. Green Apple crisp and loud, Mojito cool and cheeky, Watermelon big and bold.

settings.title: Built to be fun
settings.body: Caffeine-free, slim-can, share-it-around fun. Made for picnics, houseboats and drives.

settings.title: Founder-run and local
settings.body: Bootstrapped from J&K by a local founder who wanted Kashmir to have a soda worth bragging about.

settings.title: Made in Kashmir
settings.body: Brewed and canned in the valley by a local J&K founder. The real deal, made in Kashmir.

settings.title: Three bold flavours
settings.body: Green Apple, Mojito (non-alcoholic) and Watermelon. One valley, three moods.

settings.title: Caffeine-free, any-time
settings.body: Caffeine-free and full of bold bubbles — for the picnic, the houseboat and the drive home.

settings.title: Slim, giftable, ready to travel
settings.body: Slim 300 ml cans, and a 12-can box that ships across India.
